# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** Around eleven years old when introduced, reaching her teens and later getting married and having a child  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v3 c28 P23](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0023), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Member of the Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 c2 P0](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v3 c29 P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is an extremely attractive girl possessing rosy cheeks, dimples, and dark black eyes and hair inherited from her mother. She wears stylish gowns and dresses neat and lady-like as she grows older. Following the birth of her first child, she appears as a pale young mother whose eyes shine with ecstasy.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)_

## Personality

Isolde has a cheerful disposition inherited from her father, complemented by intelligence, goodness, and lady-like manners. She spends much of her time reading with her father's encouragement and assistance. Though fond of literature and romantic sentiments, she is more practical and sensible than her best friend Nell, while remaining deeply devoted, loyal, and generous to those she loves.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c15 P15](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0015), [v3 c28 P16](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0016)_

## History

Isolde Pembroke resides at Pear Hill in Brierley. After returning home from visiting her aunt in Delford, she meets Nell Harcourt and the two girls become bosom friends, forming playhouses and sharing imaginative adventures. Their friendship survives a temporary ban imposed by her strict mother after an accidental intoxication incident with raspberry cordial. During a visit from her wealthy, stern aunt Miss Lavinia Pembroke, Isolde and Nell accidentally leap onto her bed in the dark, but Nell's bold confession placates Lavinia, securing music lessons for Isolde. Later, after a story writing club is formed, Isolde secretly submits Nell's story 'Evadne's Atonement' to a commercial contest, winning a twenty-five dollar prize for her friend. As she matures, Isolde becomes a member of the local Improvement Society. She eventually falls in love with Gideon Duckett and marries him in a grand traditional ceremony at Pear Hill, moving to his farm two miles away. Later, she gives birth to a son.
